prompts.name: warehouse
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down mobile game nine-slice WALL CAP texture. Generate ONE square 1024x1024 opaque texture, wall top fills the entire square to the image edges. Warm burnt terracotta brick masonry, light copper clay bricks, tiny pale mortar lines; chunky charcoal steel perimeter edging with evenly spaced rivets. Distinct from dark grey floor. Brick color #BC8058. Use first reference ONLY for material inspiration. Strict orthographic top view, no perspective, no side faces, no cast shadow. Detailed hand-painted game realism with readable broad surfaces and restrained fine texture. The outer 10 percent on all four sides is a continuous raised dark metal rim, centre 80 percent is the repeating material. Narrow bevel highlights, tiny bolts on perimeter only. Centre material must tile cleanly without a central emblem. NO crates, props, characters, UI, words, letters, numbers, warning tape, logo, blood, floor, background, margins, transparent corner or checkerboard. The game engine supplies the side faces and shadows separately. This is an original game material, not a screenshot.
